articles.title: Berlin Pride attack suspect raised red flags, group says, amid questions about prior release from prison despite ISIS ties - CBS News
articles.description: Officials said Abdul Ballout, a 21-year-old German-born citizen with Lebanese roots, plowed a vehicle into celebrants at one of Europe's largest Pride events.
articles.content: The suspect in the Berlin LGBTQ+ Pride parade attack, who officials said was known to have ties to ISIS, was about to be disqualified from a deradicalization program after staff saw red flags, one of… [+6729 chars]
